purpose: A text in English (user 2026-11-11: the words of an OFF, so that SigLIP 2 finds the pictures and the captions of the shots), as a plug-in program beside the application. The AI catalog of the host names the program, the model and the languages it translates from; nothing falls back to another engine.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time.

translate.ok: { texts: [text] }: each text in English, in the order given

rules: At most 16 texts a request, each at most 4000 bytes. The plug-in reads the model and writes nothing.
acceptance: crates/qnc-text-translate/examples/translate_with_program.rs (texts of a file through the program, only read).
